description: Answers 'what macro regime are we in, and how stressed is the S&P 500?' Give as_of (defaults to today), or nothing for the latest reading. Returns the FinzData Quantitative Model labels as known on that date - financial-conditions and risk direction, growth level and direction, inflation direction, macro quadrant (GOLDILOCKS/REFLATION/STAGFLATION/SLOWDOWN), liquidity and credit - plus the growth/inflation nowcast and the daily S&P 500 market-stress probability. Labels use each input as published on that date, never later revisions.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_quant_model
title: Get FinzData Quantitative Model readings
